build_yolov3_mobilenetv2_model: build a YOLOv3 model with MobileNetV2 backbone for COCO object detection
create_train_pipeline: create a training pipeline with random resize, flip, and photo metric distortion augmentations
configure_coco_dataloader: configure a COCO dataloader with aspect ratio batch sampling and repeat dataset

run_coco_evaluation: run COCO evaluation with bbox metric on validation dataset
